description: Fork of exp571 (no residual_lut + tied dot head, killed early at step 2000 = 1.7783). SINGLE change vs exp571: apply the SAME ln_final to BOTH the x_lut side AND the tok_emb_E.weight side of the tied dot product. logits = ln_final(x_lut) @ ln_final(tok_emb_E.weight).T. Fixes exp571's bad-init-head problem: tok_emb_E.uniform_(-0.1, 0.1) gave logit scale ~0.57 at init (near-uniform softmax over V=32768), so exp571 spent ~2000 steps recovering from that. With LN on the emb side, vocab rows have unit-variance per E -> logit scale ~sqrt(E)=~10 at init, comparable to vanilla GPT. Zero extra parameters (LN reused). LUTs are unaffected (their inputs already go through MeanAbsNorm in ln_pre, so tok_emb_E magnitude is invisible to them). Bandwidth: small bump (~3.1M extra LN-on-vocab ops per forward), negligible. Predicted: step 200 starts near exp567's 2.2561 instead of exp571's 2.8149; final closer to 1.50-1.55 if init was the dominant warmup cost. exp571 trajectory (200/800/1000/2000): 2.8149/1.9825/1.9147/1.7783, gap to exp567 closed +0.559 -> +0.116 -> still high. Refs: exp571 killed at step 2000, exp567 1.4768 (full-stream parent), exp560 tied E=64 = 1.6283, vanilla-untied exp476 1.4143 / 742 Mbits.
